title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
title_zh: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation：以像素即代码（Pixel as Code）实现智能体视觉创作
abstract_en: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB over Emu3.5 IBQ. It also provides 7.13x faster encoding and 10.93x faster decoding at batch size one on A100. In standalone evaluation, one Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode variant surpasses Kimi K3.1 Pro on the aggregate across Chart2Code, MMSVG, Design2Code, and Image2Struct. At the system level, the Nemotron-native configuration raises GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56 using the same raster generator. With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.
abstract_zh: 视觉创作既需要有表现力的图像，也需要对文字、版式和结构进行精确控制。Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation 通过 Pixel as Code 将两者结合：用学习得到的离散视觉 token 表示栅格图像，用显式程序表示结构化作品，并通过统一的生成与渲染接口为图像、矢量图形、网页和文档提供视觉反馈。基于 Nemotron 的智能体调度框架负责任务规划和栅格候选筛选，并对可编辑的结构化或混合作品进行定向修复。系统由 Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer、自回归栅格生成器 Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B 和结构化代码模型系列 Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode 支撑。在覆盖六个视觉领域的约 17.8 万张图像上，分词器相较于 Emu3.5 IBQ 将重建 PSNR 从 26.08 dB 提升至 29.57 dB；在 A100 上以批大小 1 测试时，编码和解码速度分别达到基线的 7.13 倍和 10.93 倍。独立评测中，Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode 的一个变体在四项基准的综合表现上超过 Kimi K3.1 Pro。系统级评测中，使用同一栅格生成器时，基于 Nemotron 的配置将 GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM 从 31.71 提升至 52.56。最佳配置在多数有对照结果的基准上可与 GPT Image 2 和 Nano Banana Pro 竞争。
key_points_zh: Pixel as Code 用离散视觉 token 表示栅格图像，用显式程序表示结构化作品，并通过共享的生成与渲染接口获取视觉反馈。
Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer 相较 Emu3.5 IBQ 将重建 PSNR 从 26.08 dB 提升至 29.57 dB；在 A100、批大小为 1 时，编码和解码速度分别为基线的 7.13 倍和 10.93 倍。
一个 Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode 变体在 Chart2Code、MMSVG、Design2Code 和 Image2Struct 的综合评测中超过 Kimi K3.1 Pro。
不更换栅格生成器，基于 Nemotron 的智能体配置就将 GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM 从 31.71 提升至 52.56；最佳配置在多数可比基准上可与 GPT Image 2 和 Nano Banana Pro 竞争。
